text: Camila's got her second interview at the council Thursday 23rd. Really nervous about the presentation bit. Text her good luck Wednesday night.
farid knee op 14/11, off work about six weeks after. his wife Laila is taking the time off to look after him
Dawit ran the half marathon Sunday, 1:52, absolutely buzzing. Wants to do Manchester in April.
Demi says the play opens 6th Nov at the Playhouse and runs till the 9th. She's playing the landlady. I've already got tickets for the Friday.
So Tanvi didn't get the job at the bank, they went with an internal candidate. She's gutted but says she's fine. Applying for two more next week. I should check in with her at the weekend.
oliver - hospital tues for the gallbladder thing, day case. his mum's driving him
Gabriel's band gig at the Crown on Saturday the 2nd, doors 8. Ali reckons it'll be packed.
Must ring Florin about his interview, it was this morning. Senior engineer role at Rolls.

Teresa's hip replacement went fine yesterday. Home by Friday hopefully. Her daughter Aoife is staying with her for a fortnight. Pop round once she's settled, maybe bring grapes or something less boring. She said the physio starts next Monday and she's dreading it, apparently the first sessions are brutal. Also her cat Mopsy has been staying with the neighbour.
Eamon and Zeynep doing the Great North Run together 13th Sept. First time for both. Zeynep's been training with a club, Eamon has not been training at all lol
Bilal's interview got cancelled, they've frozen hiring. Back to the drawing board for him.

Andile's piano recital is on the 30th of November, St Mary's church, 7pm. She's been practising the Chopin for months and says her hands shake just thinking about it. Her teacher Mrs Schmidt thinks she could do her diploma next year. Don't forget to buy flowers, and ask Giulia if she wants to come with me.
hiroshi - starts new job at the hospital trust on monday 4th. radiographer. moved down from leeds for it

Voice memo. Okay so Ibrahim was telling me his dad's having a heart bypass on the 18th of December, which is obviously really scary for the whole family, and his dad's quite old, he's seventy-nine. Ibrahim's flying back to Lagos on the 15th to be there and he'll be away about three weeks. I need to message him before he goes and then again after the operation to see how his dad's doing. Also he mentioned he can't really eat anything spicy at the moment because of his stomach ulcer, so maybe not the curry place when he's back.
Akira passed his driving test!! Third attempt. Taking him for a celebratory pint Friday.
Khadija's sister Naledi is getting her tonsils out next Wednesday. Bit old for it apparently, recovery is meant to be grim.
Laila - final round interview at the agency 12 Oct. Two-hour case study. Wants to borrow my blazer.
Giulia's dog Biscotti had surgery on his leg this morning, he's home now but has to wear the cone for ten days. She's exhausted.
Lena's choir concert is 7th December. She's doing a solo for the first time and is terrified. Wish her luck the day before.
Dentist 3pm tomorrow. Then pick up prescription.
Kiri hurt her shoulder at netball, physio every Tuesday for the next six weeks. She's missing the league final on 22 Nov which she's gutted about
Francesca had the results from her scan back - all clear. Huge relief. Her husband Kemal had been in bits about it for weeks.
Need to ask Kemal how the tribunal hearing went. It was last Thursday I think
Aoife applied for the head of year job at her school, hears back in a fortnight. She'd be brilliant. Fingers crossed
Adebayo Okafor, everyone calls him Bayo. Met him at Fern's barbecue. Plays five-a-side Wednesdays, supports Arsenal, works in procurement for the NHS.

Fern's mum is in hospital again, chest infection this time. Fern's been going every evening after work and is shattered. Her brother Vikram is meant to be helping but lives in Glasgow so not much use. Consultant says maybe home by the weekend. Send her a message tomorrow just to see how she's holding up.
vikram match sunday 11am cup quarter final, he's captain now. said he'd let me know if they need a lift
Fatima's daughter has her grade 5 violin exam on 3rd of March. Fatima more nervous than the kid tbh.

Ali's leaving do Friday 15th at the Albion. He got the job in Bristol, starts 1 Dec. Chipping in for a card and present, Gabriel's collecting. Ali's wife Fatima is staying here until their house sells, probably till spring, so he'll be commuting back every weekend. He mentioned he really wants a decent coffee grinder for the new flat.
Camila and her partner Florin are off to Lisbon 10th-17th next month. Camila's birthday is while they're away, the 14th. She keeps going on about a film camera, could be a good present.
Farid's knee op got pushed back again. Now looking like January. He's fed up, hasn't been able to play football since summer.
Spoke to Dawit about the job at the university, he's waiting on references. Interview was 9th Oct, they said a decision by the end of the month.
Demi's brother Oliver got into the Royal Northern for music, starts September. Whole family thrilled.
Theatre Thursday with Tanvi, 7.30. I'm driving. Dinner first at that Thai place on Mill St.
tanvi said her nan passed away last week, funeral is next tues 28th. she's taking it hard. card + maybe offer to drive her
Gabriel's got an MRI on his back Monday morning, been in pain since the move. Really worried it's a disc thing. Remind me to text him Monday afternoon.
Teresa Bianchi from accounts - goes by Tess. Her son plays rugby for county under 16s, final is 1st Feb. She's into wild swimming and hates coffee.

Rang Eamon. He's out of hospital after the appendix but still sore, can't drive for 2 weeks. Op was last Sunday, emergency, he went in thinking it was food poisoning. His boss has been decent about it and given him the rest of the month off. Kids are with his ex this weekend so he's on his own. Could drop some food round Saturday.

Zeynep's interview with the BBC is next Tuesday at 10. She's been prepping all weekend and says she feels ready. The role is a junior producer in Salford, would mean moving up from London in January if she gets it.
Bilal finally did his triathlon, Saturday just gone. Finished in just over three hours. Ask him for the photos.
Andile mentioned her husband's having his cataract done 8th of Jan. Second eye in March.
Note to self: renew passport before the 30th. Book GP appointment for knee.
hiroshi's birthday 21/11, turning 40. wife Akira planning a surprise do on the saturday 23rd, don't say anything. he's been hinting about a new road bike helmet
Ibrahim has his citizenship test on Friday. He's convinced he'll fail the history part. Quiz him on Wednesday at lunch.

Akira's dad has dementia, they're looking at care homes. She's visiting three next weekend with her brother Kemal. Really heavy for her. Their mum died two years ago so it's all fallen on them. Akira's also got an interview for a part-time role at the library on the 19th, which would help with the hours. Check in with her after the weekend.
Khadija got the promotion! Head of operations from 1st November. Send congrats and maybe drinks next week to celebrate.

Long chat with Naledi tonight. Her surgery is booked for 5th December, it's the hysterectomy she's been waiting over a year for. She's relieved it's finally happening but scared about the recovery, they're saying 6-8 weeks off work and no lifting. Her partner Lena works shifts so her mum's coming down from Durham to help for the first fortnight. Naledi's cat Pepper will need feeding the days she's in hospital, 5th to 7th probably. I said I'd do it. Should ring her the evening after surgery.
Giulia's cello recital moved from Saturday to Sunday 17th, 3pm. Same venue.
Lena and Kiri's wedding is the 3rd of August next year. Venue booked in the Lakes.
kiri's interview at Deloitte went really well apparently, second round on 4 Nov
francesca's mum fell and broke her wrist, in a cast 6 wks. F doing all the shopping for her now on top of work
Get Kemal something for after his op, he likes those fancy chocolate oranges. Op is Thursday the 20th.
Aoife had her baby scan today, it's a girl. Due 2nd of April. Her and Eamon are over the moon.
Adebayo's charity boxing match is 29th Nov, he's been training for four months. Need to buy a ticket before they sell out.
Fern got turned down for the deputy head job, second time. Thinking of leaving teaching altogether. Not in a good place.
Vikram's away 9-16 Dec, his sister's wedding in Delhi. Whole family going. Look after the plants.
Fatima's back at work after her op. Says she's tired but okay. Lunch with her Thursday.
Bins out tonight. Gym tomorrow 7am.

Oliver had a panic attack before his audition on Friday but still went in and nailed it, they offered him the part on the spot. Opening night 2nd Feb. Oliver's girlfriend Demi wants a group of us to go. Book tickets once they're on sale, should be early December.
Camila's dad's knee replacement was the 3rd. Recovery slow, he's struggling with the stairs. She's going up to Leeds every weekend this month.
